description: Ayman Diab's agent skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. Three skills: eagle-eye, which lays coupled decisions out as a morphological box and renders a page that reads any configuration back; groundtrack, which draws a plan or a written change as a call graph a reader can step through; and contract, which interviews a person to agree the terms for a skill or an agent, then generates its file from that contract.
